tasks.short: Standardise dosage, immunisation and manufacturing procedures

steps.what: Gather and compare evidence for drug dosages, immunization methods and manufacturing procedures

loop.purpose: Extract comparable findings from supplied sources
loop.input: Approved source documents and scientist-defined extraction fields
loop.output: Evidence table with source passages, units and limitations
loop.check: Scientist checks every extracted value, population, qualification and source passage; missing findings remain explicit
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction per source, then manual extraction
loop.why_not_simpler: Source findings and limitations are expressed in varied prose; fixed fields alone cannot interpret them

steps.what: Calculate comparable units and compile procedure comparison tables
Judge evidence and propose standards within the authorised scientific remit
Check and approve the scientific proposal for formal governance review

tasks.design: Use a bounded extraction helper on approved sources in {DOCS}, then deterministic comparison calculations in {SPREADSHEET}. The scientist verifies evidence and calculations, chooses the proposal and approves the exact package for the existing governance process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing differently expressed findings and rebuilding calculation tables takes repeated effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound extraction and tested calculation scripts can assist preparation without deciding standards.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence quality, applicability, uncertainty and authority to adopt a standard.
tasks.human_edge: Judging whether comparability is scientifically justified and evidence is sufficient.
tasks.altitude: Less preparation; no new prescribing or manufacturing release authority.

reach.task: Agree traceability requirements for a procedure comparison

evidence.claim: Elicit supports evidence screening and extraction; this establishes a preparation capability, not automatic safe standard setting.
The calculation design and task-specific savings are E1 estimates.

assumptions: Boundary is scientific standardisation work through proposal submission; formal adoption, prescribing and manufacturing release remain separate authorised processes.

In s1 the scientist defines the question and extraction fields and verifies source identity, population, method, value, units and limitations. All source selection, capture and verification remain within its 12 retained hours.

S2 accepts only the table verified in s1 and comparison rules approved through existing scientific governance. The scientist checks rule applicability in its eight retained hours; missing units or incompatible populations trigger manual comparison.
Test native extraction and spreadsheet formulas first. Existing database runtime earns no saving; no patient dosage is chosen automatically.
research_questions: How much preparation time remains after checking all extracted qualifications and unit conversions?

already_counted.description: Source selection, extraction capture and semantic verification

incremental.description: Maintain extraction fields, calculation tests and change controls

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposal, source versions, comparison rules, calculations, limitations and governance recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=20*0.60+20*0.40+45+15=80; gross=20, upkeep=4, net=16. High assumes comparable sources; low assumes difficult evidence leaves only 4 gross hours offsetting upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define questions and an approved study plan for physiological processes
Collect and verify health and physiological measurements under the study plan
Clean measurements and compute prespecified summaries for health processes
Interpret physiological findings and decide further investigation

tasks.design: Keep study design, measurement and interpretation with the scientist. Test native analysis features before scripting repeatable checks and prespecified summaries in {DATA_PLATFORM}, retaining scientist review of exclusions, units and results.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated dataset cleaning and summary construction are manually rebuilt.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned deterministic analysis can reproduce agreed calculations and surface exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: Measurement validity, missingness and interpreting associations without unsupported causal claims.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing meaningful questions and recognising when the data cannot answer them.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive analysis assembly; scientific decisions are unchanged.

evidence.claim: SciSure provides laboratory records, sample tracking and workflows; this supports governed data capture, not the physiological analysis savings estimated here.
Prespecified deterministic summaries and the savings scenario are E1 proposals.

assumptions: Boundary is the scientist's study design, own measurement, analysis and interpretation, excluding clinical treatment and other researchers' labour.
In fully retained s2 the scientist produces pseudonymous record identifiers, measurement names, values, units, times, methods and missingness reasons. Capture and verification are not saved.

The scientist defines variables, permitted exclusions and summary rules in fully retained s1. Existing ethical and access approvals must precede collection; their external review is outside this labour boundary.
S3 never silently imputes data or chooses methods. Unsupported formats and anomalies require manual handling within its eight retained hours; test native tools before custom scripts.
research_questions: Do reproducible summaries reduce preparation time after anomaly review?

already_counted.description: Check analysis results, exclusions and data anomalies

incremental.description: Maintain analysis versions, mappings and regression examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=25+40+20*0.40+15=88; gross=12, upkeep=3, net=9. High assumes recurring analysis; low assumes existing automation leaves no gross saving while upkeep remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define questions and prespecified analysis for diseases or parasites
Collect and verify observations under the authorised investigation protocol
Prepare reproducible comparisons of disease observations and study results
Investigate competing explanations and interpret findings about diseases or parasites

tasks.design: Use versioned deterministic checks and prespecified summaries in {DATA_PLATFORM} for an authorised investigation. Keep observations, protocol choices and interpretation with the scientist, with explicit exceptions for incompatible or incomplete data.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated joins, quality checks and comparison tables are rebuilt across analyses.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable tested transformations can reproduce agreed analyses without selecting research conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Confounding, uncertain measurements and determining what the evidence supports.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguishing plausible explanations from demonstrated mechanisms.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated table preparation; investigation decisions remain human.

reach.task: Agree observation provenance and sample traceability

evidence.claim: nf-core supplies versioned, containerised and tested bioinformatics pipelines; this supports reproducible computation where an appropriate pipeline exists, not all disease investigations.
The generic comparison workflow and time savings are E1 estimates.

assumptions: Boundary is the scientist's own research work, excluding other laboratory staff and any clinical treatment. Overlapping physiological-study analysis is assigned once in a roll-up.

The scientist defines the analysis and permitted comparisons in fully retained s1. In fully retained s2 the scientist produces observation identifiers, values, units, times, methods and provenance; first capture is never free.
S3 accepts only verified inputs and prespecified rules. Missing provenance, incompatible formats and unusual observations require manual investigation in its ten retained hours.
Test existing native analysis and suitable validated pipelines before custom code. No automatic protocol selection or causal inference is claimed.
unknowns: Investigation type and approved data access
research_questions: How much repeated comparison work remains after source and exception checks?

already_counted.description: Verify comparisons and resolve input anomalies

incremental.description: Maintain transformations, provenance mappings and known-data checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=20+40+25*0.40+15=85; gross=15, upkeep=3, net=12. High assumes repeated comparisons; low assumes existing pipelines already remove that work and upkeep yields a 3-hour net cost.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer on health safety standards and improvement programmes

steps.what: Prepare source-backed options for health safety standards and improvement programs

loop.purpose: Draft options from supplied evidence and standards
loop.input: Scientist-selected sources, question and comparison headings
loop.output: Options brief with source passages and limitations
loop.check: Scientist verifies each claim, uncertainty and source, and checks the brief does not imply agreement or authority
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual preparation
loop.why_not_simpler: Summarising differently worded evidence and caveats requires semantic reading

steps.what: Confer with health departments, industry personnel and physicians on standards and programmes
Record discussion outcomes and agreed follow-up responsibilities

tasks.design: Use a source-bound drafting helper in {DOCS} to prepare an options brief. Keep stakeholder discussion human and use a native structured record for the scientist's own captured outcomes; neither draft nor record adopts a public standard.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation combines varied source texts, while follow-up details are copied into recurring record formats.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting and reusable record fields can reduce preparation and formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling scientific uncertainty with stakeholder priorities and legal responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiating feasible standards and stating uncertainty clearly.
tasks.altitude: Less brief assembly and record formatting; public authority remains unchanged.

reach.task: Compare a proposed standard with workplace implementation constraints

evidence.claim: Benchling AI drafts study reports from laboratory information; this supports source-bound drafting capability, not public-health standard adoption or negotiation savings.
The options brief, native record design and savings are E1 proposals.

assumptions: Boundary includes scientist preparation, discussion and internal record, excluding formal public adoption and other stakeholders' labour.
In s1 the scientist supplies the question, authorised source versions and comparison headings and checks meaning; capture and review remain in its 15 retained hours.

The scientist captures outcome, owner, due date, unresolved issue and agreement status in s3, within its nine retained hours. No transcript or structured agreement flag arrives for free; incomplete outcomes remain manual.
Test native drafting and record templates first. Internal discussion records do not send instructions, bind others or claim consensus beyond what was agreed.
unknowns: Permitted sources and confidential meeting material
research_questions: Does source-bound drafting save time after checking every option and qualification?

already_counted.description: Source selection, brief corrections and meaning checks
First capture and verification of discussion outcomes

incremental.description: Maintain brief instructions, record fields and access checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=25*0.60+60+15*0.60=84; gross=16, upkeep=3, net=13. High assumes reusable preparation and record formats; low assumes unusual evidence leaves only 3 gross hours offsetting upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated evidence and analysis preparation can shrink; study design, interpretation and standards decisions remain accountable scientific work.
reach: Discuss implementation constraints with safety specialists
role.ambitious_version: Use preparation savings for stronger scrutiny of competing scientific explanations, without expanding clinical authority.
